input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement (including all Service Option Attachments) or any Service Option Attachment (with the exception of any Service Option Attachment that is a prerequisite for the provision of Services under a non-terminated Service Option Attachment) for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:
input.rationale: Section 3.4 lets us terminate for convenience, but the right is only effective "at the end of any calendar month" on one month's notice, and nothing in Section 3.4 or 3.5 refunds prepaid charges - Section 3.5 only accelerates our accrued payment obligations. We therefore target the preferred position: operations 1 and 2 remove the month-end effectiveness anchor and set our notice at thirty (30) days, and operation 3 adds IBM's pro-rata refund of prepaid charges for the post-termination period. On the Vendor side no change is needed: IBM has no mid-term convenience right, its only exits being material breach (3.3) and end-of-term non-renewal on ninety (90) days' notice (3.2). We note but do not press a cap on the Attachment A early termination charges, which is a fallback-level point we can revert to if IBM resists.

ops.oldText: for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:
a. providing at least one month's prior written notice to IBM; and
ops.newText: a. providing at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to IBM; and

ops.text: IBM will refund prepaid charges for the period after the effective date of termination on a pro-rata basis.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have taken our preferred position on convenience termination: we may exit on thirty (30) days' prior written notice without waiting for a calendar month-end, and IBM refunds prepaid charges pro rata for the period after termination. We can discuss a fallback of longer notice if IBM needs it.
proposal.summary: Customer convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid charges

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.
mappings.quote: unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
